|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">浮遊式の捕虜尋問用ドロイド。注射針で自白剤を投与し、診断器具で“手術”を施す。センサーで、対象がどの程度の苦痛に耐えられるか、真実を話しているかなどを判断できる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' IT-O (Eyetee-Oh).

'''Card text:'''
If at Detention Block Corridor during the control phase, your Force drains there are +X. X equals the number of captives present. This droid is not affected by Restraining Bolt.

'''Lore:'''
A floating prisoner interrogation droid. It gives truth drugs with a syringe needle and performs surgery with diagnostic tools. Sensors can judge how much pain the subject can endure and whether the subject is telling the truth.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The power line prints 尋問用ドロイド instead of ability.
